params.body:
## What

The Koppelingen of a story now each say what they do, and Collecties now does something.

- **Collecties points at the collection pages** (Couture, Couture², Costume), the pages under Collecties in the menu. Before, it pointed at the collection documents, and the site did nothing with them. There are only two collection documents for three pages: one of them holds Couture and Couture² together and sets up the dealer portal. The site's companion change in Hoet-design/hoet-eyewear shows a story at the foot of each collection page it chose, in a "Stories over" row, as a frame page already does. The picker only offers the collection pages of the story's brand, and the links stay weak.
- **Field help:**
  - **Monturen:** they appear as cards under the story, and the story appears on the frame page.
  - **Collecties:** the story appears at the foot of that collection page.
  - **Tags:** they are not visible on the site. They choose which stories come first under "Meer stories", they go to search engines as keywords, and they only start to matter with a handful of stories.

Neither published story has a collection set, so no data changes.

## Checked

- 100 tests pass (`vitest`, without the token-bound `config.test.ts`), including the new `tests/story-links.test.ts`. `config.test.ts` checks that a story's collections belong to its brand; collection pages carry a brand, so that check keeps working.
- `tsc` passes, and `sanity schema validate` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- Not yet seen in a running Studio, which sits behind the login.

## After merge

`npm run deploy` for the Studio.
params.title: Link stories to collection pages and explain the link fields
